description: definition.render:v1 — the n8n Logical Query node's phase call (AM-33: a phase, layer er, the estate's dialect): PostStemi renders as SQL over entities reading {as_of}; a phase whose bearer has no E-R landing is refused on er, never rendered partially.
invariants: refusal over guess — an ambiguous slot is a finding, never a choice; a refused frame lowers to nothing
a refusal is not an error — it is a result with its cn findings (A-CN-57)
deterministic — the same call on the same snapshot is byte-equal

SELECT patient.patient_id
FROM patient
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM "condition"
  WHERE "condition".patient_id = patient.patient_id AND "condition".code IN (
    SELECT code_closure.descendant_code
    FROM code_closure
    WHERE code_closure.ancestor_code = 'X21'
  ) AND "condition".onset <= {as_of}
)
